proof:
intro a t f g
have hB : ∀ r : ℝ, KdVPlan.B (r+a) f g = KdVPlan.S (-a) (KdVPlan.B r (KdVPlan.S a f) (KdVPlan.S a g)) := by
  intro r
  unfold KdVPlan.B
  simp_rw [yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 r a]
  rw [← yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 (-a) (-r)]
  congr 1
  ring
funext k
change (1/2 : ℂ) * (∫ s in a..t, KdVPlan.B s f g k) = _
rw [← yui_aux_0004 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 a t (fun s => KdVPlan.B s f g k)]
simp_rw [hB]
change (1/2 : ℂ) * (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t-a, Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((-a * (k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.B r (KdVPlan.S a f) (KdVPlan.S a g) k) = _
rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
change (1/2 : ℂ) * (_ * _) = _ * ((1/2 : ℂ) * (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t-a, KdVPlan.B r (KdVPlan.S a f) (KdVPlan.S a g) k))
